title: Playbook versioning and localized runbook inserts for PagerDuty + Slack hooks
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: When incidents fire across regions we lack a single source of truth for which runbook version should be suggested in PagerDuty/Snoozes and Slack incident starter threads. Consequences: engineers get outdated remediation steps, non-English teams get poor translations, postmortem evidence is fragmented. Goal: build a Playbook Versioning Service and a localized runbook insert pipeline so PD/Slack hooks surface the correct versioned and localized playbook fragment, with audit trail and tie-in to postmortem automation.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook Versioning Service deployed behind feature flag (can store semantic version + metadata)
PD hook can query service and attach a versioned runbook snippet to new incidents
Slack incident starter inserts localized runbook for user's locale header and links to canonical playbook
Audit log recording playbook version, locale, and requestor for every attachment
E2E test that simulates incident creation and verifies correct version and locale selection
No increase in PD alert latency > 150ms p95 (baseline measured)
Security review completed for templates (no secret leakage)
tasks: Design schema for playbook versions and metadata (owner, region tags, minimum runtime)
Implement Playbook Versioning Service (CRUD + semantic lookup API)
Add localization pipeline: markdown templates + locale mappings + fallback rules
Instrument PD and Slack hook adapters to call versioning service with incident context
Write audit logger and forward to observability pipeline (trace + event)
Create integration tests and simulate multi-region incidents
Prepare rollout feature flag and gradual enablement script
Author docs and runbook authoring guide for PMs/SEs
comments: 2026-02-11 - Maya Chen: Spiked on existing runbook storage. Current bundles live in Confluence and Drive; need canonical Git-backed store. Initial POC will keep templates in repo to simplify CI.

2026-02-18 - Liam O'Connor: Design review notes: prefer semantic versions (v1.2.0) + region tags rather than per-incident forks. We also need a fallback lookup chain: exact locale -> region default -> en-US.
2026-02-24 - Priya Shah (PM): Asked for audit fields to include playbook_sha and template_source (drive|git). Also requested a simple UI in Console later to browse versions.
2026-03-02 - Security review (initial): flagged potential for credentials in templates. Decided templates must be linted to strip inline secrets; secret patterns list to be added to pipeline.

2026-03-05 - Eng sync: Prototype PD adapter implemented. Observed PD hook p50 adds ~40ms and p95 ~120ms when service is cold. Plan: cache recent lookups in PD-adapter for 30s to reduce repeated calls during incident storms.
2026-03-11 - QA: Integration test failing for fr-CA locale due to missing region mapping. Added fallback mapping and updated test fixtures.
decision_log: Keep templates as Markdown files in a dedicated git repo for first phase to enable CI linting and PR reviews.
Semantic versions and immutable shas required for auditability; UI will show latest recommended version per region.
Localization will use locale tags (e.g., fr-CA) and fallback to region or en-US; no machine-translation in first rollout.
Caching: PD/Slack adapters will maintain a short TTL in-memory cache (30s) and a Redis fallback for cross-worker consistency.
Audit trail: emit a structured event containing incident_id, playbook_key, playbook_version, sha, locale, and adapter_id to telemetry pipeline.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: behind feature flag in staging. Runbook repo read-only, adapters query versioning service but do not attach snippets.
Phase 1: enable attachments for internal teams only (alpha). Monitor PD latency and error rate dashboards for 72h.
Phase 2: expand to customer-facing incidents with a throttled rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
Phase 3: enable Console UI for browsing versions and manually pinning per-project playbooks.
Rollback strategy: feature flag off and adapters fall back to current behavior of attaching static link to canonical playbook.
